commands.disposition: Pre-existing fixture/SDK contract mismatch; see residual below.

assessment: Inspected all eleven changed files and installed SDK/provider implementations before conclusions.

UI timer removed. Session continuation retains account lock/context fencing while installed SDK observes exact saved message keys at checkpointed tip and exact saved claim hash. Receipt/finality wait results do not bypass original custody, canonical-effect, fee-ceiling or journal checks.
Pause fences subsequent stages and retains the current owned call until settlement. Already-attempted or ambiguous claims are never automatically resubmitted.

Relay submit response is validated and its hash retained only as a recovery hint; missing hash remains payment-pending without false confirmation. A lost response reconciles status of the sole original request. Relay status drains existing operation before reading saved state.

Installed ethers supports finalized number events and waitForTransaction(hash, confirmations, timeout); installed Aztec messaging and transaction waiter signatures match the calls. No custom retry scheduler or elapsed-time success condition added.

residuals.test: ordinary claim-deposit saved bytes survives restart with immutable consent
residuals.evidence: Reproduced on candidate. replacementFixture is byte-identical to base923; its node.sendTx/getTxReceipt return plain objects lacking isPending/isDropped/isMined/hasExecutionSucceeded. Unchanged shared/transaction-outcomes.mjs delegates those objects to installed waitForTx, which calls these methods; exception becomes BB_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN. realJournalFixture also has the same plain-receipt shape. Candidate application change only preserves not-ready reason.
residuals.limit: No broad recovery suite or baseline full run; not claiming wider application qualification. Repair those receipt doubles at their existing SDK boundary before using these tests as acceptance evidence.

required_before_runtime_acceptance: Rebuild generated SDK and wallet assets from this source: shared/sdk-entry.mjs adds messaging waiter export. Complete normal integration gate.
limits: Focused component, controlled relay and labelled browser checks only. No service, full journey, proof or live transaction; no source edits.
